necessary_context.content: Lemma 13 gives a rotated block decomposition with residual Wtilde whose conditional law satisfies d/(d-T) times Wtilde distributed as Wishart(d-T). Appendix C.2 constructs query-dependent left rotations and Gaussian-factor right rotations, with residual Gaussian entries of variance 1/d.

necessary_context.content: Lemma 14 states arbitrary A and symmetric residual W, but its proof uses A^{-T} and does not write the Rayleigh normalization; no unrestricted version is endorsed here. Theorem 10 proof p.12 prints Wishart(T-d), while Lemma 13 uses dimension d-T. The adopted local derivation must explicitly state its eigenvalue scaling and threshold expressions. Corollary 12 is stated on p.10; Appendix C.1 supplies separate eigenvalue-index and event conventions. These observations are source fidelity notes, not a local proof.
